fdroid:app.knotwork.android.name: Knotwork: build your agent
fdroid:app.knotwork.android.summary: An AI agent that runs on your phone and asks before it acts
fdroid:app.knotwork.android.description:
Knotwork is an AI agent that runs its model on the phone. Instead of a prompt box wired to somebody's API, every conversation runs through a pipeline you can open and edit: a graph of typed nodes - input, on-device LLM, optional cloud LLM, tool call, routing, decomposition, evaluation, clarification, output. When a step wants to do something destructive or sensitive, it stops and asks you first - including in the background, where the confirmation arrives as a notification.
WHAT IT DOES
- Runs on your device. On-device inference through LiteRT-LM, with optional GPU acceleration; CPU-only works, just slower. Cloud providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Groq) and a server you run (Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible one) are optional and use your own key.
- You build the behaviour. A drag-and-drop editor with pan and pinch-zoom, snap-to-grid, auto-layout, inline validation and a run-trace overlay, across 14 node types. Prompt variables such as $DATE, $TIME, $TOOLS, $MODEL and $MEMORY_SUMMARY render fresh on every run.
- Tools, gated by you. Built-in tools and external servers through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). By default every sensitive or destructive call stops for explicit confirmation, enforced where the tool executes, not merely suggested to the model.
- Reaches you from outside the app. A share target, launcher shortcuts and a Quick Settings tile run your chosen pipeline over shared text or images. Triggers (time, charging, Wi-Fi, network) fire a pipeline on their own and report back. Every entry surface stays inert until you bind a pipeline to it.
- Remembers what matters. Long-term memory with semantic retrieval over past conversations, automatic fact extraction, search and export.
- In your language. The screens, the bundled pipelines and the help come in English, Russian and Spanish. What a model reads stays in English.
WHO IT IS FOR
It is for the person who already runs Tasker, Obsidian, Home Assistant or a local model on their own hardware, and who wants to know exactly what their agent does with their data.
PRIVACY
There is no account, no sign-in and no server of mine. Inference runs on the phone, so a normal conversation never leaves it. Data goes out only along paths the privacy policy lists, each off until you switch it on - except the built-in Wikipedia lookup, on by default. Usage statistics stay on the device and are never transmitted; a build-time check fails the build if any network dependency reaches that code. The database - chats, memory, run traces - is SQLCipher-encrypted, and API keys are sealed under an Android Keystore key. Crash reporting is opt-in, off by default, and absent entirely from the FOSS build.
KNOWN LIMITATIONS
This is a pre-release. The public surface, the settings layout and the on-device storage formats can still change between versions.
- Android 14+ and about 2 GB of free RAM - the memory is the real constraint.
- On some phones the screen freezes while the model runs on the GPU; switch it to CPU.
- Shared pipeline files are not a compatibility contract before 1.0. Keep the original.
- Background runs need the battery setting on Unrestricted. Without it Android reclaims the process in about ten seconds - the platform's rule, not a bug, but until you grant it background pipelines will not run.
- Cloud failure behaviour differs by provider: detection of a stream that dies mid-answer is enabled only where it was measured.
- Other apps' AppFunctions are out of reach - Android keeps the permission to call one for system apps. The local catalogue is what ships, plus whatever you connect over MCP.
- One maintainer, no company behind it.
Open source under the Apache License 2.0; source, documentation and an FAQ are on the developer website.

Since these goals and requirements are not precise, unclear situations are discussed and decided on a case-by-case basis.

flathub:io.github.ungoogled_software.ung.name: Ungoogled Chromium
flathub:io.github.ungoogled_software.ung.description:
Ungoogled Chromium is Google Chromium, sans dependency on Google web services. It also features
 some tweaks to enhance privacy, control, and transparency (almost all of which require manual
 activation or enabling) .
 Ungoogled Chromium retains the default Chromium experience as closely as possible. Unlike other
 Chromium forks that have their own visions of a web browser, Ungoogled Chromium is essentially
 a drop-in replacement for Chromium.
 Without signing in to a Google Account, Chromium does pretty well in terms of security and privacy.
 However, Chromium still has some dependency on Google web services and binaries. In addition, Google
 designed Chromium to be easy and intuitive for users, which means they compromise on transparency
 and control of inner operations.
 Ungoogled Chromium addresses these issues in the following ways:
 Remove all remaining background requests to any web services while building and running the
 browser
 Remove all code specific to Google web services
 Remove all uses of pre-made binaries from the source code, and replace them with user-provided
 alternatives when possible
 Disable features that inhibit control and transparency, and add or modify features that promote
 them (these changes will almost always require manual activation or enabling)
 These features are implemented as configuration flags, patches, and custom scripts.

 (SBC) infrastructure. By centralizing computing resources in the data center rather than distributing

 and applications are published from a central location, providing a seamless and familiar environment

 in a server-based solution, increases the availability as well.
 ThinLinc combines the tools and infrastructure required for Linux-based SBC into a mature, stable,

firefox-addons:3067917.name: Fresh Tomato - A Productivity tools
firefox-addons:3067917.summary:
Fresh Tomato is an ADHD-friendly, privacy-focused productivity tool designed to help you start, focus, and finish your work without distractions.
It combines a Pomodoro timer ,tasks, checklists, habits, notes,bookmarks, reminders, planner and more..
firefox-addons:3067917.description:
Start, focus, finish. One tomato at a time. 
Fresh Tomato is an ADHD-friendly Pomodoro timer that grew into a calm, complete productivity workspace: tasks, checklists, notes, bookmarks, habits, a focus forest, ambient sounds, reminders, a prayer tracker, a day planner and gentle insights, all inside one distraction-free shell that works fully offline.
No accounts. No servers. No tracking. Your data lives on your device and nowhere else.
Most productivity tools assume you already have momentum. Fresh Tomato assumes you do not, and it is designed around that.
- Gentle streaks that pause instead of breaking when life happens
- A five-minute starter and a breathing exercise for the moment you cannot begin
- Drift shield to notice when you have wandered, without shaming you for it
- One-task mode so only a single thing exists on screen
- Calm mode and reduced motion switches that stop the interface from pulling at your attention
- Comfort presets in one tap: "Calm and clear" or "Low distraction"
- Honest empty states everywhere. Nothing ever looks broken or accusatory
 🍅 Today 
One calm home: current focus, the timer, energy and mood check-ins, session chips and the day at a glance.
 ⏱ Pomodoro timer 
Focus, short and long breaks with auto-flow, skip, crash recovery and keyboard-first control.
 ✓ Tasks 
Quick capture, priorities, tags, chunking, one-task mode and quick complete, all one keystroke away.
 ☰ Checklists 
Reusable lists with three starter templates, drag-free reordering and progress chips.
 🗓 Planner 
Plan today and tomorrow, and move leftovers forward without guilt.
 🎯 Habits 
Gentle streaks, weekly rhythm and per-habit history.
 🌳 Forest 
Every finished focus session grows a tree. Water it with deep work and watch the forest fill in.
 📝 Notes 
A lined-paper writing surface with bold, italic, lists, checkboxes, headings, undo and redo, find and replace, and a live preview.
 🔖 Bookmarks 
A full local link manager: save, open in one click, favourite, tag, search, sort and import or export. Real site logos are fetched once and stored inside your entries, so they still appear offline.
 🖍 Highlights and 📌 Keep 
Right-click any page to highlight a sentence in one of five marker colours, or clip it to a reading list you can check off and turn into a real task later. Highlights are re-painted automatically every time you reopen the page.
 ⏱ Time Tracker 
See where your browsing time actually goes: daily totals, top sites, a 12-week consistency heatmap, weekday patterns, personal records and optional gentle limits. Private windows are excluded, and tracking stays local.
 🎧 Ambient sounds 
Rain, café, forest and more, with volume, sleep timer and playback that follows you across pages.
 ⏰ Reminders 
One-off and repeating nudges with gentle notifications and sound.
 🧘 Focus tools 
Focus mode, quick notes, parking lot, five-minute starter, breathing exercise and drift shield.
 📈 Insights 
Where the day went, focus trends, a heatmap and an activity feed. Numbers without judgement.
 🛡Focus Shield 
Guardrails that protect your attention — nudges and guard pages that respect your choices and Blocked sites you choice 🚧.
 🔄Backup & Restore 
Snapshots of everything — tasks, notes, tags, logs and settings — kept on this device only.
Everything stays on this device — yours alone.
This extension is built on a simple promise, and the app states it plainly in Settings:
 Storage: your device only. Nothing is uploaded, ever.
 Network: none for your data. No servers, no accounts, no analytics, no telemetry.
 Data collection: none. Declared as "none" in the manifest.
 Offline: the entire extension works with no internet connection.
 Backups: one-tap snapshots plus export and import as a plain JSON file, so you can move your data anywhere.
 Retention: your writing and captures are kept forever by default. You choose whether history is trimmed, and the app shows your live storage footprint.
 Fresh Tomato is for anyone who has ever opened a to-do app, felt overwhelmed, and closed it again. Start small. One tomato is enough. 
 Support: https://buymeacoffee.com/monessem
